description: Each garden's Safe on Arbitrum One that holds the USDC for its promise rewards and pays them through RewardPayer (PRD-1556), with the Hats Signer Gate v2 that keeps the Safe's signers to the garden's stewards. A garden's own account never holds USDC. A garden missing here has no USDC part: the Hub offers none at Create and pays none. An entry names the garden's token id, its garden account, the Safe, its gate, and the garden's steward hat as a decimal string: { "tokenId": 2, "garden": "0x...", "safe": "0x...", "gate": "0x...", "signerHat": "2480..." }.
